description.content:

in all states (`requested`, `in_progress`, `completed`, `aborted`).

item.name: Retrieves the status of a backup of a WordPress installation

request.name: Retrieves the status of a backup of a WordPress installation

description.content:
Retrieves the status of a backup of a WordPress installation.
Possible statuses include
- `requested`
- `in_progress`
- `completed`
- `aborted`
`initiated` has been deprecated for `in_progress`.

to the state captured in the specified backup.
